title: 5.4.7 Lab: Score a gap
description: A pipe the bird has flown past is worth a point, once. The starter shows a score that never moves. Give every pipe a flag that remembers it has been counted, the same idea as 5.3.7 with a different trigger.

steps.title: Notice the bird got past
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, loop over the pipes. A pipe has been passed when its `x` is less than the bird's `x`. The score is already on screen, starting at 0: `drawTop()` at the bottom of the starter shows it on top of the pipes.
hints: `for (const p of pipes) { ... }` visits each pipe; the pipes are already built, with a `passed` property that starts `false`. The index loop from 5.4.6 works too, with `pipes[i]` in place of `p`.

steps.title: Count each pipe once
steps.instructions: Inside that test, add one to the score and set `p.passed = true`. Without the flag, the test is true on every frame after the bird passes, and the score races like the ball did in 5.3.5.
hints: Run it: the score should rise by exactly one as each pipe slides behind the bird.

requirements.title: Every pipe is checked
requirements.description: A loop looks at each pipe in the array (a for...of loop or an index loop). Help: 5.3.8 (Lab: Three bumpers, three values)

requirements.title: A pipe is passed when it is behind the bird
requirements.description: The pipe's x is compared with the bird's x and the pipe's own flag. Help: 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event)

requirements.title: Each pipe is counted once
requirements.description: The score goes up and the pipe is flagged in the same step. Help: 5.3.5 (Reading: A collision is not an event)
